name: Edinburgh Summer Open 2024
information:
Everyone is welcome to compete in this competition, and all competitors are eligible to win medals for podium positions. However, if you are a first-time competitor you may be more interested in the [Edinburgh Summer Beginners 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EdinburghSummerBeginners2024) competition. 

PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Edinburgh Summer Beginners 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EdinburghSummerBeginners2024). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EdinburghSummerOpen2024#40344-series-competition).

Please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.
